claims.claim: The dissertation reports Cannabis accessions that flowered under continuous light and interprets those results as suggesting multiple genes can control photoperiod insensitivity in the studied germplasm.
limitations: The result is evidence from the studied accessions and supports a multi-gene interpretation; it does not establish a universal genetic architecture for every photoperiod-insensitive Cannabis line.

scope.study_context: Jacob Toth 2022 Cornell PhD dissertation; accessions evaluated under continuous light

claims.claim: In the dissertation's high-CBD cultivars, a flowering-stage time-course under several biotic and abiotic stresses found the CBD:THC ratio was essentially fixed.
limitations: This is scoped to the high-CBD cultivars, flowering-stage time course, and stresses studied in the dissertation; do not generalize the ratio as invariant across all Cannabis genetics or environments.

scope.study_context: Jacob Toth 2022 Cornell PhD dissertation; high-CBD cultivars under studied biotic and abiotic stresses

claims.claim: The dissertation reports mapping two major flowering-time loci on chromosome 1, named Autoflower1 and Early1.
limitations: Treat as a result from the dissertation's studied germplasm and analyses; do not generalize the loci as sufficient to predict flowering behavior in every Cannabis genotype.

scope.study_context: Jacob Toth 2022 Cornell PhD dissertation flowering-time genetics
